title: AC charging: before you start
body: Park safely first. This guide covers pre-checks and the start of AC charging for the 2024 Korean-market IONIQ 5 only, not DC fast charging, portable ICCB, V2L or emergency release. Check charging on the vehicle and charger directly; follow that charger's instructions for connection and disconnection.

steps.title: Check people, site and equipment
steps.body: Use a designated EV charger matching the voltage and maximum current on the vehicle's charging label, and the genuine cable for this vehicle where equipped.
official_cautions: Charger electromagnetic fields can fatally interfere with medical-device operation. If you use a pacemaker or another electrical medical device, ask your clinician and device maker about effects before charging.
Use a waterproof charger. Do not connect or disconnect with wet hands, or stand in water or snow when connecting the cable.
Do not charge if lightning is possible or rain could reach connector or plug joints.
Do not use a damaged, corroded, rusty or loose cable, connector or plug; have it inspected. Replace any cable with damaged insulation with a new one. Do not use an extension lead.
Keep the cable clean and dry; do not modify or disassemble it.

steps.title: Park and check the connections
steps.body: Hold the brake, apply the parking brake, turn electrical switches off, select P and turn the vehicle off. Ensure the connector, plug and inlet are free of water, dust and debris. Follow the charger manual; hold the vehicle-side AC connector by its handle and insert it into the inlet until it clicks.
official_cautions: Keep hands and body away from mating parts; do not pull the cable. Poor connections can cause fire or electric shock.
Do not force a frozen charging door or drop a connector.
Charge only in P. Keep hands away from the cooling fan: it can run even with the vehicle off.

steps.title: Check the start on the vehicle
steps.body: Immediately after connection, check that the cluster charging-connector indicator lights (displayed for about 1 minute). Once charging starts, the estimated time also appears for about 1 minute. Scheduled charging or climate settings may show -- for the estimate.
official_cautions: Stop charging immediately if unusual smells, smoke or other abnormalities occur.
Time estimates vary with battery condition and age, charger specifications and temperature. If charging does not start, consult the official manual and charger instructions.
